featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Stay productive in your home office or meeting room with HALO 90 multi-functional speakerphone. It is integrated with HDMI, USB-C and USB-A ports, offering you a variety of connectivity options as well as great conferencing convenience. Just connect HALO 90 to your PC via a single USB-C cable, and you can easily charge your PC while also connecting it to a display, a keyboard and a mouse, plus get on a conference call - all at the same time.

Designed with the latest dual USB 3.2 type-A interface, HALO 90 speakerphone supports up to 10Gbps lightning-speed data transmission. You can connect a 4K camera or ultra-high-speed SSD device, and transfer large media files in seconds via its USB ports.

HALO 90 speakerphone also supports up to 85W reverse charging. Simply plug in your USB-C power adapter or display to its USB-C port, then you can easily charge your PC, with no need to worry about running out of power.

HALO 90 speakerphone supports acoustic echo cancellation, active background noise reduction and voice enhancement. Its outstanding audio quality can ensure everyone is heard during conference calls, making your meeting more efficient.

HALO 90 speakerphone features a 2W speaker, which can cover any space of a 30?O meeting room, so you won‘t miss a word. Furthermore, the AGC technology balances out voice volume in real-time to ensure no one sounds too close or too far away from it.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

HALO 90 speakerphone is compatible with all leading UC platforms, like Zoom, Skype, Teams, WebEx, etc. You can easily connect with colleagues around the world for a seamless meeting experience, whatever platform you‘re using.

HALO 90 speakerphone is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS, Windows 7/8/10/11, Android and iOS. Connect it to your computer via USB cable and you can make a conference call just in a few seconds.
